# Biology Roots

> Biology Roots provides comprehensive STAAR test prep and ATLAS curriculum resources for biology education and teacher support.

Biology Roots is an educational platform dedicated to helping teachers and students master biology through structured STAAR preparation materials and ATLAS curriculum resources. The site offers free lesson plans, anatomy resources, and teacher tools designed to support science education.

## Key Topics

- ATLAS curriculum
